reason: The image-only first reading covered only leaves 1-2 and took the Magnus lessons and several chant cues as uncertain; with the vitae and the passio at hand the lessons on leaves 1r, 1v, 3r and 6r were reread and corrected on the images (for example 'queque', 'Campidonensi', 'fidissimum amicum').
sources: Eucherius, Passio Acaunensium martyrum c. 3, ed. B. Krusch, MGH SRM III (1896), pp. 33-34 (archive.org passionesvitaequesanctorum1, page images n54-n55)
Vita S. Magni (BHL 5162d), ed. M. Coens, Analecta Bollandiana 81 (1963), pp. 326, 327, 331 (Google Books snippets only, id ixcX7fA0f1wC); BHL Novum supplementum (1986) p. 560
Vita S. Magni (BHL 5163), Acta Sanctorum Septembris II (1748), p. 755 §64-65 and the bear episode (archive.org bub_gb_xqBtiYcRc7sC, page images n850 and n831)
Stephen of Liège, Vita S. Lamberti §5, PL 132, col. 645 (archive.org patrologiaecursu0132mign, page image n328)
Hincmar, Vita Remigii c. 1 (BHL 7152), ed. B. Krusch, MGH SRM III (1896), p. 260 lines 4-10 (archive.org passionesvitaequesanctorum1, page image n281)
Cantus Index standard texts 004591, 002217, 007677, 006184 (Nativity of the Virgin) and 602157 (Lambert responsory)
text:
F-m4fu (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 84): source-assisted reading. The lines below were reread on the images, with the source texts at hand.

Lines reread on the image:
- leaf 1r col. a, complete
- leaf 1r col. b, lower two-thirds
- leaf 1v col. a, from the sixth lesson onward
- leaf 3r cols. a and b, top 13 lines each
- leaf 6r col. b, top 13 lines
- leaf 11r col. a, top 13 lines
All other text rests on the image-only first reading or is unread.

Conventions:
- Native-pixel boxes refer to the 7360 x 4912 canvas images.
- ( ) marks expansions, [ ] lost or supplied letters, (?) an uncertain reading, / a line end, and ... text not read.
